challenges.challenge: Do two labels or phase action lose generated alternatives?
challenges.resolution: twoLabelUnit evaluates the actual source product; everyPositionRetainsBoth uses generated prefix/suffix membership and coordinate inequality. completeRowMembership proves both membership directions; phaseRetainsCompleteSupport retains exact word projection, branch count and distinctness.

challenges.challenge: Do marginal recovery and correlation assume parsing the joint separator or discard component provenance?
challenges.resolution: Cell retains the actual original pair and jointBranch equation. everyPairCell and nonempty opposite support establish both marginal equivalences. allFalseWitness extracts actual failed cross pairs; equality of either coordinate contradicts missing-cell membership. everyComponentRecordRetained composes exact joint rows with record reconstruction.

challenges.challenge: Do phase merging and selected observation erase predecessor phases or unselected branches?
challenges.resolution: zeroShift and branch induction restore the full state after a period; predecessorFibreExactly retains the full word/phase row. totalObservationRelation supplies every original classification, closedDistinctionRetained keeps each unselected row, and reconstructEntireState is equality of the complete State.
